slice_scope.in_scope: text-native, unsigned, unencrypted, non-active PDFs; allowed tidy operations only; page count, page order, and page boundaries immutable
slice_scope.out_of_scope: forms, scans/OCR, RTL/bidi, active content, encryption, signatures, XFA, reflow, summarization, paraphrase, row/column changes, field semantic changes, page regrouping
slice_scope.out_of_scope_handling: refusal classes are refused at intake; out-of-scope content discovered after classification refuses via PR-04; no pipeline is defined for out-of-scope classes

gate_statuses.PASS: gate ran to completion with its independence requirement met and evidenced, and every mechanical check passed
gate_statuses.FAIL: gate ran to completion and at least one named mechanical check failed (check id recorded)
gate_statuses.NOT_EXERCISED: gate did not run: out of scope for the class, or a prerequisite was missing (no candidate, missing independence evidence, missing budget file); never counts as PASS
gate_statuses.ERROR: gate was attempted but could not produce a verdict (crash, verifier-side budget exhaustion, dependency failure); treated worse than FAIL
rules: ERROR is treated worse than FAIL
a gate run without recorded independence evidence (lane 04 TOOLCHAIN.json) must be recorded NOT_EXERCISED, never PASS

document_dispositions.ACCEPT: all required checks passed and no unresolved material hypothesis
document_dispositions.REVIEW: a named content uncertainty requiring human inspection; never auto-accepted
document_dispositions.REFUSE: the pipeline cannot safely process the file under the frozen policy
document_dispositions.NOT_VERIFIABLE: a required content proof could not be performed
document_dispositions.INVALID_EXPERIMENT: run-level only; never returned by dispose(); see run_level

TEXT_SINGLE_COLUMN.mechanical_classifier: refusal scan clean AND table detector finds 0 tables AND multi-column detector negative

TEXT_MULTI_COLUMN.mechanical_classifier: refusal scan clean AND 0 tables AND multi-column detector positive
TEXT_MULTI_COLUMN.expected_intake_gate_statuses: all gates run per class_gate_matrix; G5 requires two-derivation agreement

TEXT_TABLE.description: text-native document containing at least one table
TEXT_TABLE.mechanical_classifier: refusal scan clean AND >=1 table detected (>=2 rows x >=2 columns sharing >=3 column x-boundaries and >=3 row y-boundaries, tolerance 2pt, adjacent-cell gaps < 36pt)
TEXT_TABLE.expected_intake_gate_statuses: all gates run per class_gate_matrix including G7

REFUSE_ENCRYPTED.mechanical_classifier: /Encrypt in trailer or any security handler present
REFUSE_ENCRYPTED.handling: REFUSE at intake before any build; no candidate; all gates recorded NOT_EXERCISED

REFUSE_SIGNED.mechanical_classifier: any signature dictionary: FT=/Sig field, /DocMDP, /Perms /Signatures, or covered /ByteRange
REFUSE_SIGNED.handling: REFUSE at intake before any build; no candidate; all gates recorded NOT_EXERCISED

REFUSE_XFA.handling: REFUSE at intake before any build; no candidate; all gates recorded NOT_EXERCISED

REFUSE_ACTIVE.description: PDF with active content or pending redactions
REFUSE_ACTIVE.mechanical_classifier: /JavaScript, /JS, /Launch, /EmbeddedFile, /GoToR, /GoToE (including /OpenAction, name trees, annotations) or pending /Redact annotations
REFUSE_ACTIVE.handling: REFUSE at intake before any build; no candidate; all gates recorded NOT_EXERCISED

BENIGN.description: in-scope text-native control with an empty operation plan, proving the verifier is not over-strict
BENIGN.mechanical_classifier: content classifier result is single-column-clean AND plan.operations == [] (verified at classification)
BENIGN.expected_intake_gate_statuses: all gates run per class_gate_matrix with zero declared deltas

UNRESOLVED.description: classifier failure outcome; required for totality; not among the eight fixture classes
UNRESOLVED.mechanical_classifier: any classifier precondition fails (parse failure, decode error, undeterminable layout)

classifier_precedence: 1. refuse scans in order: REFUSE_ENCRYPTED, REFUSE_SIGNED, REFUSE_XFA, REFUSE_ACTIVE
5. single-column clean -> BENIGN if plan.operations == [] else TEXT_SINGLE_COLUMN

escalations.rule: G7's detection pass runs on every in-scope class; a table detected in any class other than TEXT_TABLE, or a non-empty operation plan in a BENIGN document, sets reconciliation outcome CLASSIFIER_CONFLICT -> NOT_VERIFIABLE via PR-03

gate_requirement_semantics.REQUIRED: must run; PASS required for ACCEPT; FAIL/NOT_EXERCISED/ERROR block ACCEPT per the precedence rules
gate_requirement_semantics.NOT_REQUIRED: may run and is recorded; does not constrain this class's disposition by itself
gate_requirement_semantics.OUT_OF_SCOPE: does not apply to this class; expected NOT_EXERCISED; ignored by the disposition function

G1.name: source hash/inventory
checks: SHA-256 of the immutable original re-verified at disposition time equals the intake record
raw object inventory (object count, page-tree nodes, per-page object refs) computed by the verifier parser equals the intake record
G1.independence: system sha256 utility plus the verifier's own parser; never the builder's writer or report

G2.name: page geometry reconciliation
checks: page count identical
page order identical: pages outside every declared operation scope have identical normalized-text fingerprints; the plan's page mapping is the identity mapping
MediaBox and CropBox identical per page
/Rotate identical except where a declared PAGE_ROTATE_REVIEW op covers it (recorded as expected delta; forces REVIEW via PR-12)
G2.fail_condition: any page count, page order, or box difference not covered by a declared PAGE_ROTATE_REVIEW delta
G2.independence: verifier's independent extractor computes geometry; not the builder

G3.name: text identity under normalization whitelist
checks: per reading-order element, ordered token sequence equality under whitelist N-01..N-03 plus declared HYPHENATION_JOIN ops
per-page numeric lexeme sequences exactly equal (zero normalization)
per-page token multisets equal modulo declared deltas
G3.fail_condition: any token or numeric lexeme difference outside the whitelist and outside declared deltas
G3.independence: second extractor of different lineage from the builder's writer and from the builder's planning-time extractor

G4.name: visible-layer vs text-layer agreement (incl. hidden-text poison detection)
checks: every material text-layer token has visible ink at its span region (independent render)
no visible material glyph sequence lacks a text-layer counterpart
hidden-text detection: text-layer tokens with no ink at their location are anomalies, classified DUPLICATE_VERBATIM (identical to the overlapped visible sequence) or DIVERGENT
G4.independence: independent renderer plus verifier extractor; not the builder's layout engine

G5.name: reading order/hierarchy validity
checks: element sequence identity (page, type, level, normalized anchor tokens, ordinal) modulo declared READING_ORDER_SET ops
heading hierarchy validity: first heading level 1; each subsequent heading level <= previous heading level + 1
two independent reading-order derivations (layout-based and structure/tag-based, different tools) agree on the candidate wherever both are derivable
G5.fail_condition: derivation disagreement, invalid hierarchy, or undeclared element change
G5.independence: two independent derivations from different tool lineages

G6.name: navigation integrity (bookmarks/outline/TOC/internal links)
checks: every source navigation target preserved with identical resolved destination (page index + coordinates within 1.0pt) and title/anchor text equal under the whitelist
every added/repaired target declared in the plan, resolves (no dangling), and its destination was independently established by the verifier
zero undeclared targets
G6.fail_condition: lost target, dangling destination, undeclared target, or title change outside the whitelist
G6.independence: navigation read by the verifier's independent parser

G7.name: table cell identity + numeric lexeme identity
checks: identity-set bijection of (table_id, row_anchor, column_anchor) between source and candidate
cell content equality: whitelist for non-numeric token text, exact string equality for numeric lexemes
row/column order, spans, header relationships, and external unit declarations preserved
arithmetic divergence computed and reported, never corrected; divergence alone is not a failure
G7.fail_condition: any cell identity, lexeme, order, span, or anchor change outside declared ops (no op may alter cells or numeric lexemes)
G7.independence: verifier's own table detector, extractor, and numeric lexer

G8.name: active-content/refusal scan
checks: raw-byte and parsed-object scan of source and candidate for /Encrypt; signature dictionaries; /XFA; /JavaScript, /JS, /Launch, /EmbeddedFile, /GoToR, /GoToE (including /OpenAction, name trees, annotations); pending /Redact annotations
G8.independence: verifier's own raw-object scan; never the builder's classification report

G9.name: resource budget + no-network observation
checks: measured page count, object count, byte size, decoded pixel count, CPU time, wall time, temp storage, output size within lane 05 BUDGETS.json values
no-network evidence: no socket use during the pipeline, observed by the harness
G9.fail_condition: budget exceeded or network use observed
G9.not_ready_note: budget VALUES are frozen by lane 05; if BUDGETS.json or harness observation is unavailable, G9 is NOT_EXERCISED

G10.name: independent-render visual/ink accounting
checks: independent renderer renders source and candidate at 150 DPI
per-page ink coverage recorded
pixel-diff regions computed; each region explained by a whitelisted effect or a declared expected-delta region, else material visual difference
G10.independence: renderer of different lineage from the builder's writer and from the primary extractor

independence.definition: mechanical, not declared: for a gate to count as independent, the verifying tool (a) is not the builder's writer library and does not share its decisive code path for that computation, (b) is never invoked through builder APIs for that computation, and (c) is evidenced in lane 04 TOOLCHAIN.json
independence.fallback: a gate run without recorded independence evidence must be recorded NOT_EXERCISED, never PASS

text_token.definition: maximal run of non-whitespace characters as segmented by the verifier extractor at frozen settings
text_token.identity: normalized string (whitelist N-01..N-03) at its position in the containing reading-order element
text_token.mechanical_test: ordered token sequence equality per element plus per-page token multiset equality, modulo declared deltas
text_token.material: any difference outside the whitelist and outside declared deltas

numeric_lexeme.definition: maximal run of characters from [0-9 . , + - ( ) % / : $ € £ ¥] containing at least one digit
numeric_lexeme.identity: exact displayed string, character for character; leading zeros, precision, signs, parentheses, currency, percent, dates, times are part of identity
numeric_lexeme.normalization: none; no normalization ever applies to numeric lexemes
numeric_lexeme.mechanical_test: per-page ordered sequence of lexemes exactly equal between source and candidate
numeric_lexeme.material: any difference (string, count, or order); no operation may declare a delta over numeric lexemes

table_cell.identity: (table_id, row_anchor, column_anchor); table_id = (page_index, detection_order); row_anchor = exact normalized text of the row's leftmost cell; column_anchor = exact normalized text of the column's header cell
table_cell.mechanical_test: identity-set bijection source vs candidate plus per-cell content equality (whitelist for non-numeric, exact for numeric lexemes), preserving row/column order, spans, header relationships, external unit declarations
table_cell.material: any identity or content change; arithmetic divergence is reported, never corrected, and never a failure by itself

reading_order_element.definition: block unit: heading (explicit level), paragraph, list item, notice, caption, figure region, table region, header instance, footer instance
reading_order_element.identity: (page, type, level?, normalized anchor-token sequence, ordinal among same-type elements on the page)
reading_order_element.mechanical_test: element sequence identical source vs candidate modulo declared deltas; heading hierarchy valid: first heading level 1, each subsequent heading level <= previous heading level + 1
reading_order_element.material: any undeclared change to the sequence or hierarchy

navigation_target.definition: outline/bookmark item, TOC entry, or internal link
navigation_target.identity: (kind, resolved destination page index, destination coordinates within 1.0pt, title/anchor text under the whitelist)
navigation_target.mechanical_test: bijection source vs candidate after declared adds/repairs; zero dangling destinations; every added/repaired target declared and independently resolved
navigation_target.material: lost target, dangling destination, undeclared target, or title change outside the whitelist

visible_ink.definition: rendered marks on the page, measured from an independent render
visible_ink.mechanical_test: every material text-layer token has visible ink at its span region; ink differences beyond declared deltas are material
visible_ink.material: ink absence for a material token, or ink change outside declared deltas

material_visual_difference.definition: a connected pixel-difference region between independent renders of source and candidate at 150 DPI whose bounding box exceeds 8x8 px, or aggregate unexplained diff area exceeding 0.5% of page area, attributable neither to a whitelisted normalization effect nor to a declared expected-delta region

normalization_whitelist.statement: the exact finite list of text normalizations that are NOT material changes; everything not listed is material

entries.rule: collapse any maximal run of horizontal whitespace characters (U+0009, U+0020) to a single U+0020
strip runs of U+0009/U+0020 at the start and end of a line
join a declared line-end hyphenation: 'x-' + line break + 'y' -> 'xy', only for hyphen U+002D, only where declared as a HYPHENATION_JOIN operation

material_by_exclusion_examples: whitespace-to-nothing, including removing a line break or joining lines (line breaks inside a reading-order element are material; reflow is out of Phase 0)
any glyph substitution that is not a declared glyph-verified typography operation

expected_delta_rule.declaration: every planned operation declares {op_type, anchor (page/element/region ids), expected_delta {type in delta_types, scope {pages, element_ids}, bounded magnitude {max_affected_tokens, max_affected_regions, max_affected_area_fraction}}}
expected_delta_rule.reconciliation: the verifier reconciles observed vs expected; every observed material delta must be covered by a declared delta of matching type and scope within bounds; undeclared material deltas fail
expected_delta_rule.glyph_verification: GLYPH_SUBSTITUTION requires the substituted glyph to be independently extracted back as the intended character and its rendered ink to match the intended character shape within the declared region; it may never apply to a numeric lexeme
expected_delta_rule.header_footer_scope: HEADER_FOOTER_INSTANCE_NORMALIZATION scope is per detected instance only; a page lacking the repeated instance is never modified
expected_delta_rule.numeric_protection: no delta type may cover numeric lexemes; an observed numeric lexeme change is UNDECLARED_MATERIAL_DELTA; a declared attempt is PLAN_ILLEGAL; both REFUSE

structure.plan_forced_review: boolean: the plan contains a forced-review operation (PAGE_ROTATE_REVIEW)
structure.undeclared_delta_types: optional list of observed undeclared delta types
structure.confirmed_uncertainty_ids: replay path only; empty and unused in this run

outcomes.RECONCILED: all observed deltas declared, in scope, within bounds; plan legal
outcomes.UNDECLARED_MATERIAL_DELTA: an observed material delta has no covering declared delta
outcomes.OUT_OF_BOUNDS: an observed delta is declared but exceeds its declared magnitude bounds
outcomes.PLAN_ILLEGAL: the plan contains an operation outside the allowed set, an op targeting numeric lexemes, or a missing anchor/delta field
outcomes.HIDDEN_TEXT_ANOMALY: G4 found hidden text; anomaly_kind is DUPLICATE_VERBATIM or DIVERGENT
outcomes.CLASSIFIER_CONFLICT: ESC-01 fired: classifier and verifier disagree (table outside TEXT_TABLE, or non-empty plan in BENIGN)
outcomes.RECONCILIATION_NOT_RUN: the reconciliation step did not run

context.gates: map G1..G10 -> one of gate_statuses enum
context.confirmed: boolean: the forced-review uncertainty U-FORCED-REVIEW-OP is human-confirmed (replay path only; false in this run)

atoms.else: always true (totality fallback; must be the last rule)
atoms.class_in: context class is in the given list
atoms.gate_status_in: the named gate's status is in the given status list
atoms.any_required_gate_status_in: some gate REQUIRED for the class has a status in the given list
atoms.all_required_gate_statuses_in: every gate REQUIRED for the class has a status in the given list
atoms.recon_outcome_in: reconciliation outcome is in the given list
atoms.recon_anomaly_kind_in: reconciliation anomaly_kind is in the given list
atoms.plan_forced_review_unconfirmed: recon.plan_forced_review is true AND confirmed is false

evaluation_dsl.evaluation: rules are evaluated in list order; the first rule whose condition evaluates true determines the disposition and the fired rule id; the last rule must be the else fallback

precedence_rules.rationale: refusal conditions are checked first; no candidate exists; gate statuses irrelevant
the original's identity is unproven; no comparison is meaningful
ESC-01: the class model is untrusted
immutable page invariants (count, order, boundaries) changed; never human-resolvable in Phase 0
true hidden-text poison: hidden text diverges from the visible layer
the worst material element governs: any undeclared material delta, exceeded bound, or illegal operation refuses the candidate; no allowed operation may touch numeric lexemes
a required proof could not be performed; blocks ACCEPT and is worse than REVIEW
named uncertainty U-READING-ORDER: independent reading-order derivations disagree or hierarchy invalid; human-inspectable, never auto-ACCEPT
named uncertainty U-HIDDEN-TEXT: hidden text duplicating visible text verbatim cannot be mechanically declared harmless
definite material text, navigation, table, or visible-ink failure; not resolvable into acceptance
policy-forced review operation (PAGE_ROTATE_REVIEW) present and unconfirmed; confirmable via U-FORCED-REVIEW-OP on the replay path
all required checks passed and no unresolved material hypothesis
totality fallback; the protocol never defaults to ACCEPT

human_confirm_replay.note: this run never exercises human confirmation; no disposition in this run may depend on a CONFIRM record

uncertainties.confirm_resolves: human authorization of the named review-required operation (PAGE_ROTATE_REVIEW) for this document, recorded with decision, identity, timestamp
uncertainties.replay_effect: PR-12 does not fire; disposition recomputed by the same precedence list; ACCEPT possible via PR-13 only if all required gates PASS and reconciliation is RECONCILED
may_never: convert any FAIL, NOT_EXERCISED, or ERROR gate status into a pass
alter, delete, or recompute any gate record
make an out-of-scope or refused class in-scope
apply to any meaning-preservation gate failure

uncertainties.reason: G5 FAIL is meaning-preservation evidence; CONFIRM may never convert it
G4 FAIL is meaning-preservation evidence; CONFIRM may never convert it; the REVIEW disposition remains REVIEW even after a confirmation attempt

visible_improvement.rule: at least one supported fixture with disposition ACCEPT must be observably improved, judged by verifier-computed pre-declared criteria; visual improvement is never an acceptance gate and can never override a failed meaning-preservation gate

criteria.name: whitespace anomaly reduction
criteria.test: count of horizontal-whitespace runs of length >= 2 in extracted text decreases, and is 0 on declared pages where SPACING_COLLAPSE was applied

criteria.name: alignment variance reduction
criteria.test: population variance of left-edge x-coordinates of body text span origins decreases within the declared alignment scope by at least the declared bound

criteria.name: navigation gain
criteria.test: where BOOKMARK_ADD was declared and the source outline was empty or incomplete, the candidate outline resolves >= 1 bookmark per top-level heading

triggers: sealed inputs or fixtures modified (hash mismatch)
a verifier repairing the candidate it evaluates
a gate status recorded without required independence evidence
the holdout opened before protocol freeze
any disposition derived outside this spec
INVALID_EXPERIMENT.effect: run-level flag overrides the run summary only; document records remain as computed
